name: player_process_pending_contact_queues
description: Player::ProcessPendingContactQueues clears stale pending contacts, rebuilds the per-frame contact queues, dispatches each non-empty queue in the original order, and leaves tier S to a Player collision-source cluster pass.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this dispatcher; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player collision/source-cluster pass.

The smoke covers the flag reset, stale queue clearing, BuildPendingContactQueues call, and early no-contact return. The non-empty queue branches are backed by Binary Ninja evidence plus focused functional smokes for the individual callees.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x423460 validates saveState in ECX, playerState at saveState+4, reset of the five per-frame processed/resolved/notified flags, ClearPendingContactQueues before BuildPendingContactQueues, the early return when noPendingContactsQueued is non-zero, then checkpoint, pickup, player-collision, world-collision, transfer, and preferred-collision processing in that order before final ClearPendingContactQueues.

The native smoke seeds a stale preferred-collision contact, verifies that ProcessPendingContactQueues clears it, resets all per-frame dispatch flags, rebuilds probe world caches through BuildPendingContactQueues, records no queued contacts, and returns without setting any dispatch flag.
